learning.why: Teacher's story about the spoon staying the same while peels changed finally made me see that plastic and foil don't rot into soil.
The teacher's story showed me that the plastic spoon was still there after two months, so it doesn't turn into mitti; foil must be the same.

end.summary: Discussed shared responsibility for a clean, green and safe school.
end.parentNote: Anika practised ways to keep school clean and safe, including using bins and washing plates. They sorted vegetable peels and dry leaves as wet waste for the green bin and compost pit, and identified Maggi packets as dry waste. Anika initially thought foil and plastic would become soil; this was revisited, and they later said these would remain unchanged, though the lesson record marks the mix-up as not fully corrected. At home, practise sorting a few household items into wet and dry waste and explain why.
